description: High-resolution wind power generation time series for Germany in the period 2000-2015 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Raik Becker (Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research GmbH - UFZ, Leipzig, Germany). High-resolution wind power generation time series for Germany in the period 2000-2015. A paper describing the applied methodology can be found in this repository as well. The final temporal resolution is hourly and the spatial resolution NUTS 3. The data is stored in csv and hdf5 files. More information on the data set, e.g. Coverage: national (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
